Person / Kairova archive district
Defining feature
Always carries a broken scanner and jokes when nervous
Strength 1

Paired limitation 1

Strength 2
Night vision
Paired limitation 2
Bright light overwhelms the sensor
Audience
The Kairova Civic Records Recovery Team needs a clear way to identify the original entry records and remove the duplicates.
Purpose
The report explains how to find the duplicated records, protect the original files, and prevent the system from copying them again.
Meaning
Success protects the citizens’ information and gives the next response crew a clear process they can trust.
Discovery
An discovered that every duplicate had the same timestamp and scanner error code. The broken scanner’s retry mode was copying each entry whenever the archive lights flickered.
Problem
The records looked almost identical, the scanner was unreliable, and the bright emergency lights interfered with An’s night vision.
Response
An used pattern recognition to separate the original records from the copies. Then An turned off the scanner’s retry mode, removed the duplicates, and tested the system again.
Outcome
The original records were restored and the archive system returned to normal. An left a reliable recovery guide for the next crew and joked that the scanner had finally stopped making new friends.
